# File Object

## Summary
Base-realm embedded-object file renderer (PDFs and other browser-embeddable
documents). Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/file-resources` (named export
`FileObject`).

## Usage
```gts
import { FileObject } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/file-resources';

<FileObject @model={{this.documentFile}} />
```
File renderers take a FileDef-backed model (an uploaded realm file) — an
example instance requires an actual uploaded file, so these specs document
the contract and defer live examples to a file-fixtures pass (flagged for
review).
